items.name: vois-tokens
items.title: Vois tokens
items.description: Default values for every Vois token, generated from the Vois Figma variables, with a generic blue brand, plus the motion tokens and the shape roles in their own files. Use it when the Vois MCP isn't serving your workspace's live values.

items.name: vois-theme
items.title: Vois theme
items.description: Points every shadcn/ui variable at its Vois token (vois-tokens DS-TOKEN-005). Ships no color values. Import it after Tailwind.

items.name: vois-spinner
items.title: Vois Spinner
items.description: One open arc turning in a circle (the loading.dev arc, MIT), timed by --motion-duration-spin, still under reduced motion, currentColor, sizes 16/20/24. The Button's loading state uses it.

items.name: vois-button
items.title: Vois Button
items.description: shadcn/ui's Button on Vois tokens: the same variant and size names, heights 28/36/48 (36 is the web default, 48 the native default) and 56 circular, a centered label with 4px sides, leading and trailing icons, a loading state with the Vois spinner, the Vois focus ring and hit area, and a pointer-only press scale timed by the motion tokens. Install vois-spinner with it.

items.name: vois-input
items.title: Vois Input
items.description: shadcn/ui's Input on Vois tokens: 36 (web default), 48 (native) and 32 (compact, inline in tables), with the Figma Input Field states (hover, 2px focus, error via aria-invalid, disabled, read-only, prefill).

items.name: vois-select
items.title: Vois Select
items.description: shadcn/ui's Select (Radix) on Vois tokens: a trigger with the Vois Input heights and states, and a list built like the Figma Dropdown Menu and Menu Item. Install vois-input with it: the trigger imports its field classes.

items.name: vois-checkbox
items.title: Vois Checkbox
items.description: shadcn/ui's Checkbox (Radix) on Vois tokens, from the Figma Checkbox set: a 24 box with a 2px inside border, checked and indeterminate marks, disabled, the --control-focus ring, an aux variant for strong backgrounds, and a 44 hit area.

items.name: vois-switch
items.title: Vois Switch
items.description: shadcn/ui's Switch (Radix) on Vois tokens, from the Figma Web and iOS Switch sets: 32 x 20 on web and 52 x 32 native, a knob that slides in --motion-duration-fast (still under reduced motion), disabled, the --border-state-focus ring and a 44 hit area. For a setting that takes effect at once.

items.name: vois-radio-group
items.title: Vois Radio Group
items.description: shadcn/ui's RadioGroup (Radix) on Vois tokens, from the Figma Radio set: a 22 circle with a 3px --control-border ring that grows to an 8px --control-on ring when selected (a 6px hole), disabled, an aux variant, the --border-state-focus ring, arrow keys with one tab stop, and a 44 hit area.

items.name: vois-tabs
items.title: Vois Tabs
items.description: shadcn/ui's Tabs (Radix) on Vois tokens, in two styles from Figma: pill (the default, the Tab set: 28 or 40 tall, --tab-* fills) and underline (the Tab Nav set: 48 tall, a 2px --border-accent edge when active). Disabled wins over active, and arrow keys move between tabs.
